purpose.zh: 将 Max 价格调整为 6 个月 119 美元和 12 个月 199 美元，并让公开页面、会员面板、Stripe、SmartPay 与 AI 咨询使用同一套中心价格。
purpose.en: Change Max pricing to USD $119 for six months and USD $199 for twelve months while keeping public pages, the member dashboard, Stripe, SmartPay, and AI guidance on one central catalog.

zh: Max 6 个月价格由 $59 调整为 $119，Max 12 个月价格由 $99 调整为 $199。
Stripe 卡或银行账户付款继续按精确美元价格收取；Polygon SmartPay 的 USDT 保持 119 / 199，GLC 按已验证的 Konectible 10 美元档位规则分别映射为 120M / 200M。
首页、订阅页、课程目录、会员面板、管理员课程说明与 AI 咨询同步显示新价格。
en: Change six-month Max from $59 to $119 and twelve-month Max from $99 to $199.
Keep Stripe card or bank payments on the exact USD price; Polygon SmartPay keeps exact 119 / 199 USDT while the reviewed Konectible 10-dollar bucket rule maps them to 120M / 200M GLC.
Synchronize the new price across Home, Pricing, language catalogs, the member dashboard, administrator course guidance, and AI guidance.

zh: 首页、公开订阅页、课程目录、登录会员面板、管理员课程说明、Stripe 结账、SmartPay 管理与加密结账、AI 咨询。
en: Home, public pricing, the course catalog, the signed-in membership panel, administrator course guidance, Stripe checkout, SmartPay administration and crypto checkout, and AI guidance.

zh: 只修改现有 Max 中心商品目录，不新增付款产品、结账分支或权益类型。
SmartPay5 预设从中心商品价格重新派生，因此旧链上金额不会被视为新的有效价格，需由 Owner 重新确认。
免费初级课程、一次性 7 天 Max 试用、Max 期限和 1,000 AIGC 额度包规则保持不变。
en: Change only the existing central Max product catalog without adding payment products, checkout branches, or entitlement types.
Derive SmartPay5 presets from the updated catalog so an old on-chain amount is not accepted as the new price until the Owner reconfirms it.
Keep free Beginner access, the one-time seven-day Max trial, Max terms, and the 1,000-credit AIGC pack unchanged.

zh: 自动化测试验证中心商品价格、Stripe 精确金额、SmartPay USDT / GLC 映射、公开页面与登录会员面板文案。
TypeScript、零警告 ESLint、敏感数据扫描、生产构建、D1 迁移重放与响应式 WebKit 矩阵通过。
未执行真实 Stripe 收款或真实链上转账；这两项保留给站点所有者控制的钱包与付款凭证。
en: Automated tests verify the central product prices, exact Stripe amounts, SmartPay USDT / GLC mapping, public copy, and signed-in dashboard copy.
TypeScript, zero-warning ESLint, sensitive-data scanning, production build, repeatable D1 migrations, and the responsive WebKit matrix pass.
No live Stripe charge or on-chain transfer was made; those remain controlled by the wallet and payment credentials of the site owner.

zh: 合约 Owner 必须在管理员付款页用新金额重新确认两个 Max 产品规则；本次不会代表 Owner 发起链上交易。
en: The contract Owner must reconfirm both Max product rules with the new amounts in payment administration; this release does not submit an on-chain transaction for the Owner.

zh: 课程等级、免费方案、Max 权益和 AIGC 额度结构不变；仅更新两个 Max 期限的价格。
en: Course levels, Free access, Max entitlements, and AIGC credit structure remain unchanged; only the prices of the two Max terms change.

rollback.zh: 回退至上一成功的 Cloudflare Worker 即可恢复旧目录价格；不删除已有 Max 权益、付款记录或额度余额。
rollback.en: Roll back to the previous successful Cloudflare Worker to restore the prior catalog prices; do not delete existing Max entitlements, payment records, or credit balances.
